title: Add Pannable Compose Diagram
description: Add panning to the compose/ui Diagram viewport while preserving the existing zoom, diff colors, selection, and click callbacks. Implement local pointer drag panning suitable for the mini-map/preview component and verify compose/ui type-check and Storybook build.
summary: Added pointer drag panning to the compose/ui Diagram viewport on the empty canvas while preserving zoom, diff colors, selection, and piece/connection click callbacks. Re-verified compose/ui type-check and Storybook build.
